  "strategy": "Attempt 1: replace the linear baseline with a gradient-boosted tree ensemble (hist_gbdt) to raise the ranking itself, and set an explicit class weight so the default predict() cut lands near the balanced point. Concretely: hist_gbdt with learning_rate 0.06, max_iter 500, max_leaf_nodes 63, min... (capacity via max_depth left unset), l2_regularization 1.0, early_stopping off so all 27,126 train rows are fitted, and class_weight {\\\"0\\\": 1, \\\"1\\\": 6} — slightly below the 7.55 frequency ratio, which pushes recall up without collapsing specificity. Preprocessing: impute none (hist_gbdt splits on NaN natively; there are no NaNs anyway, so this is a no-op safety choice) and no scaling, since trees are scale-invariant and V6<path> are heavily skewed. Read roc_auc / pr_auc / balanced_accuracy_at_best_cut and cut_headroom on the result: they will tell whether the remaining gap to 0.8811 is ranking (needs another family or deeper capacity, next attempt) or operating point (needs a different explicit weight).",

      "0": 1.0,
      "1": 6.0
    }
  },
  "preprocessing": {

  },
  "changes_from_last": "First attempt of the run. Relative to the card's baseline (logreg + median impute + standard scale, default cut): different family entirely (gbdt instead of linear), no scaling, imputer removed, and an explicit 1:6 class weight instead of the unweighted default.",
  "rationale": "The goal bar 0.8811 sits above the baseline ranking's ceiling of 0.8382 (KS 0.6765, required 0.7622), so no cut or weight applied to the logistic ranking can reach it — the ranking generator has to change. hist_gbdt is the strongest single tabular estimator available here and captures exactly what a linear model cannot on this file: the strong-but-nonlinear V12 (last-contact duration) effect, the skewed count columns V6<path>, and interactions among the 44 one-hot levels of V2<path> 'unknown' levels in V4 (4.1%), V9 (28.8%) and V16 (81.8%) are real categories to a tree, which can isolate them as their own branches rather than blending them into a coefficient, so the caveats cost nothing here — and I add no missingness columns, since the card reports 0% NaN and the indicators would be constant. 500 iterations at learning_rate 0.06 with 63 leaves and l2 1.0 is ample capacity for 27k rows and well inside 600 s; early_stopping is explicitly off so the fit sees all 27,126 rows and its score is comparable to the baseline's. Class weight is set explicitly at 1:6 rather than 'balanced' because balanced_accuracy needs recall and specificity balanced, and pinning at the 7.55 frequency ratio typically overshoots into low specificity; 1:6 is a deliberate point slightly inside it. The reported cut_headroom and balanced_accuracy_at_best_cut then separate the two axes for attempts 2-5: large headroom means retune the weight, small headroom with a low ceiling means push the ranking further (deeper<path> xgboost capacity or a bagging family).",
  "unsupported_claims": [
    "feature_engineering"
  ],
  "source": "llm",
  "iteration": 1
}
